purpose: Test whether one real Mail-selected Arven, after the earlier observed same-turn Mail then Beach owner sequence, can use its later legal Supporter turn to perform a native validated physical Item-plus-Tool search, while retaining an identical original source/candidate pairing and all failed/censored rows.
preexistingGenuineSourceEvidence: Run 42526888225 selected Arven OBF from genuine native Trainers' Mail top-four prompt and then settled same-turn Tropical Beach placement/use/draw in source-seat-1, trial 3:0:A.

outcomes.positive: same exact source seat Mail+Beach turn then later Store-accepted Arven and real two-category owner-deck search
outcomes.negative: no Arven selection, no later Pass, no prompt, rejected action, unsettled prompt or engine abort all remain recorded

limitations: Retrospective same seed already exposed in earlier Mail+Beach experiment, no competitive policy comparison, no card legality, no game-win inference, no claim that same seed proves identical physical opening without explicit witness.
objectiveContribution: First full Item->Stadium draw->next legal Supporter->Item+Tool resource chain on a genuine original Aichi source game, as a development precursor to autonomous control/attack and opponent response.
